main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess next-bar return on forecast > 0 bars

statistic.name: ordinary t of forecast/10 x excess return

main_measure.threshold: weighted mean > 0 with ordinary t of (forecast/10 x excess) >= 2 to confirm; t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: mean excess next-bar return, high-volume-ratio half minus low half (Welch t)

reading: Volume halves split active bars sorted by the recorded vol.last_history_value into the lower n//2 and upper n//2 (middle bar dropped when n is odd); the supporting check passes when high minus low > 0; the plan's 'fewer is inconclusive' minimum is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow; the situation check uses recorded component values where present and recomputes them from prices otherwise.
decided_by: The main measure's t lies between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
